missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Бабушка' stays in the nominative as the subject of 'живёт'. 'Моя' is the agreeing feminine possessive, and 'в деревне' shows the location.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Бабушку' is the accusative direct object of 'навещаю'. 'Свою' agrees in the feminine accusative, and 'часто' shows frequency.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'У бабушки' uses the genitive form after 'у' to show whose garden it is. The adjectives 'большой' and 'красивый' describe the сад.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 'Бабушке' is in the dative case as the recipient of the letter after 'пишу'. 'Длинное' agrees with the accusative object 'письмо'.
Strategic focus: Instrumental with preposition. 'Бабушкой' is the instrumental form after 'с', expressing accompaniment. A cosy everyday scene.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О бабушке' uses the prepositional form after 'о' to express the topic. 'Вечером' sets the time.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Бабушка' is nominative as the subject of 'печёт'. 'Вкусные пироги' is the accusative plural object, intensified by 'очень'.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular after a number. After 'две', the noun takes the form 'бабушки', the genitive singular used with two. 'В парке' sets the location.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 'Бабушке' is the dative recipient of the gift after 'подарил'. 'Тёплый платок' is the accusative object.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Бабушки' is the nominative plural as the subject of 'любят'. 'Наши' agrees in the plural, and 'вместе' adds togetherness.
